band_origin.easy: Complete calculation in a direct standard form after small useful cancellations. Full-answer choices require normalization and differential knowledge. No given substitution or formula.
band_origin.moderate: One familiar square normalization; inverse secant requires a small fractional differential adjustment. Definite intervals include varied familiar endpoint values and one or two nonzero contributions.
band_origin.hard: Authored coprime two-coefficient normalization for sine/tangent; source-supported absolute-value normalization for secant. Definite integrals use source-supported small radical normalization and familiar endpoint values. No larger-number proxy or all-symmetric interval rule.

support: Recognize the substitution and complete the integral; retrieve mastered facts; every rule and normalization is explained in feedback.
answer_policy: Diagnostic factor, scale and endpoint mistakes only; no copied-u or arbitrary additive offsets. All inverse antiderivatives are five-choice questions because native inverse-function exact entry is unsupported. Definite moderate/hard use exact entry.
sampling_policy: Family-first and endpoint-profile-first, before small parameters. Unique mathematical tasks per band. Delivery must retain varied endpoint profiles and normalization work. Legitimate cancellation remains eligible under easy normalization.
calibration: Imported examples support direct and square normalization for sine/tangent, and secant/hard-definite families. No imported indefinite sine/tangent hard anchors; those hard bands are explicit authored extrapolations.
